events.verdict: Sochan (SAS) reaches in and initiates contact with Young's (ATL) arm after his gather, which affects his SQBR during his driving shot attempt.
Wembanyama (SAS) establishes himself in Hunter's (ATL) path and absorbs the contact the two come together.
Hunter (ATL) grabs Wembanyama's (SAS) waist as he moves down the lane and the contact affects his ability to move freely.
Bogdanovic (ATL) contests Vassell's (SAS) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Hunter (ATL) firms up in a screening position in Sochan's (SAS) path and does not deliver contact.
Atlanta is called for a delay-of-game violation after Johnson (ATL) grabs the made basket and passes the ball to a game official.
Bogdanovic (ATL) briefly engages with Wembanyama (SAS) as he moves through the lane.
Sochan (SAS) grazes the side of Young's (ATL) face as he sets the screen and the contact is marginal.
Sochan (SAS) briefly places a hand towards Young's (ATL) front and the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Wembanyama (SAS) establishes himself in Hunter's (ATL) path and absorbs the contact as the two come together.
Nance Jr. (ATL) jumps forwards into Paul (SAS) as he contests, initiating illegal contact to his lower body during the jump shot attempt.
Sochan (SAS) moves laterally into Young (ATL) and initiates contact to his body that affects his SQBR.
Paul (SAS) briefly loses control of the ball and legally regains his dribble before ever fully establishing frontcourt position.
Hunter (ATL) places an arm around Sochan (SAS) before immediately removing it as both players pursue the rebound.
Nance Jr. (ATL) commits a take foul on Wembanyama (SAS).
Wembanyama (SAS) jumps alongside of Hunter's (ATL) path to the basket and legally contests the dunk attempt. Any arm contact between the two players is incidental.
Hunter (ATL) is assessed an unsportsmanlike technical foul.
Wembanyama (SAS) is assessed an unsportsmanlike technical foul.
Nance Jr. (ATL) briefly places an arm on Wembanyama's (SAS) back as both players compete for the ball and the contact is marginal.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Replay review of the out of bounds pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Wembanyama (SAS) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds and Atlanta is given possession.
Hunter (ATL) establishes himself in Wembanyama's (SAS) path and is firming up as the two come together during the screen.
Wembanyama (SAS) contests to the side of Young (ATL) and once Young has already returned to the floor, marginal contact occurs between the two players.
Hunter (ATL) reaches in and grazes Johnson's (SAS) left arm during his shot attempt.
Sochan (SAS) moves over the pick and grabs Hunter's (ATL) side, dislodging him from his position.
Johnson (SAS) maintains a legal guarding position defending Hunter (ATL) in the post.
Daniels (ATL) initiates contact with Paul (SAS) that affects his SQBR.
Vassell (SAS) fumbles the ball and legally regains possession.
Johnson (SAS) makes clean contact with the ball to steal it away from Young (ATL).
After Wembanyama (SAS) gains control of the loose ball, Coach Johnson (SAS) signals for and is granted a timeout while Wembanyama still has possession.
Nance Jr. (ATL) legally contests Paul's (SAS) jump shot attempt.
Johnson (ATL) does not inbound the ball within five seconds.
Wembanyama (SAS) legally contests Young's (ATL) driving shot attempt.
Young (ATL) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
